campaign.name: 34: Observational gate credit — Phase 1
campaign.objective: Observe layerwise sparse-gate credit and intended optimizer movement without changing Ninereeds' learning behavior.

contract.development_stage: foundational bootstrap: early encoder and expression coordination after Campaign 33
contract.purpose: Run a paired, bounded control and observational smoke test from one exact parent using one exact ordered lesson, then retain chat, MRI, and gate-credit evidence without promotion.
success_criteria: The control and observed branches use the same exact parent, ordered corpus, seed, optimizer policy, and evaluation suite.
The observational branch emits bounded layerwise activation-credit and optimizer-movement evidence with validated sign conventions.
Diagnostics do not consume RNG, alter gradients, optimizer state, or trained weights relative to the deterministic control.
Both branches finish with behavioral chat and MRI evidence; loss and diagnostic scalars remain telemetry and mechanistic evidence only.
failure_criteria: Diagnostics change any trained tensor or optimizer state relative to the paired control.
Any lesson row is shuffled, reordered, skipped, or admitted without its dependency certificate.
Diagnostic tensors cause unbounded artifacts, non-finite values, or material VRAM failure.
The run attempts promotion, automatic ranking, a local learning rule, Error Diffusion, or any behavior-changing intervention.
expected_regressions: The short replay lesson may cause temporary behavioral changes without constituting experimental failure.
Gate-credit alignment may be negative, near zero, unstable, or uninformative.
contract.hypothesis: Read-only observation of h and -dL/dh can expose layerwise teaching-pressure structure while leaving the exact training trajectory unchanged.
observations_sought: Layerwise raw and effective gate activity and activation-credit alignment.
Whether active gates receive strengthening or suppressing pressure across the ordered lesson.
Intended optimizer movement by architectural parameter family.
Runtime and peak-VRAM overhead of the observation path.
Any relation between gate-credit patterns, immediate behavior, and MRI geometry.

parent.selection: Campaign 33 branch 3 terminal, selected deliberately for continuity and preserved immediate protected behavior; this is not checkpoint promotion or a declaration of general superiority.
